name: Rhine-Waal University of Applied Sciences
summary: Young public university (founded 2009) on the Dutch border, in Kleve and Kamp-Lintfort; 16 of its 23 bachelor's are taught in English.

handoff.label: Programme finder: tick Bachelor and English (16)

ib.text: Apply through uni-assist; your IB must meet the KMK subject rule. IB English at 5 or more counts as B2 English. Open programmes admit everyone eligible; restricted ones rank on grade.

dates.label: Application deadline for most bachelor's (HSRW's standing winter date)

programmes.name: Agribusiness
programmes.about: Business administration and management applied to the agri-food industry: three foundation semesters, a specialisation in sustainable development, animal and plant sciences or management, then an internship or a semester abroad.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission (no NC): apply by the deadline with a recognised IB and B2 English and you get a place.

programmes.name: Bioengineering
programmes.about: Biology, chemistry and engineering combined to design biotechnological processes and products; you choose industrial, pharmaceutical or agricultural biotechnology in semesters 4–5, then do a placement or go abroad.
programmes.ib: Restricted: places ranked on your converted grade. Register on hochschulstart.de first (DoSV).
programmes.selectionNote: Restricted via hochschulstart: ranked on your converted grade if oversubscribed, but every on-time EU/EEA applicant got a place in each of the last four years.

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: A broad engineering degree that opens with an orientation semester, then lets you build your own mix of electronics, robotics, computing, product development or business subjects, with an internship or semester abroad in semester 6.
programmes.ib: Upload proof that you completed HSRW's online self-assessment with your application.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission (no NC): apply by the deadline with a recognised IB, B2 English and the self-assessment proof and you get a place.

programmes.name: Engineering for Sustainability
programmes.about: Mechanical engineering taught through projects, with sustainability built into every module; you shape a specialist or generalist profile, and semester 6 is a compulsory internship or semester abroad.
programmes.ib: Restricted: places ranked on your converted grade. Register on hochschulstart.de first (DoSV). Proof of the online self-assessment is required.
programmes.selectionNote: Restricted via hochschulstart: ranked on your converted grade if oversubscribed, but every on-time applicant got a place in 2025, its first listed year.

separateFrom.name: Engineering
separateFrom.reason: Only this one is restricted: you register on hochschulstart.de first and places are ranked on your converted grade if oversubscribed; Engineering is open admission. Both need the online self-assessment.

programmes.name: Environment and Energy
programmes.about: Environmental science, energy technology and economics around renewable energy and environmental protection: three semesters of science and engineering foundations, electives, then an internship in the sector or a semester abroad.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission (no NC): apply by the deadline with a recognised IB and B2 English and you get a place.

programmes.name: Gender and Diversity
programmes.about: Sociology, politics, cultural studies and economics applied to questions of gender and diversity, with electives in semesters 4–5 and an internship or semester abroad in semester 6.
programmes.ib: 8-week pre-study placement, proof due when you re-register for your second semester.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission (no NC): apply by the deadline with a recognised IB and B2 English and you get a place.

programmes.name: Information and Communication Design
programmes.about: Visual communication design: two foundation semesters in ideas, illustration and photography, then projects in editorial, corporate, interface, web, exhibition or information design, with an internship or semester abroad.
programmes.ib: Needs a passed portfolio assessment as well as the application. 2027 portfolio window not yet announced (last ran 29 Jan–15 Mar).
programmes.selectionNote: No NC, but you must pass a portfolio assessment (ten creative pieces, judged on observation, originality and visual communication) in its own earlier window.

programmes.name: Infotronic Systems Engineering
programmes.about: Computer science, electrical engineering and signal processing combined: four foundation semesters, then a specialisation such as AI, information security or drone technology, and an internship or semester abroad.
programmes.ib: Restricted: places ranked on your converted grade. Register on hochschulstart.de first (DoSV).
programmes.selectionNote: Restricted via hochschulstart: ranked on your converted grade if oversubscribed, but every on-time EU/EEA applicant got a place in 2023, 2024 and 2025.

programmes.name: International Business Administration
programmes.about: Business administration for international markets: marketing, strategy, HR and accounting at the core, six electives chosen from fifteen (from consumer psychology to SAP), and a semester abroad or internship in semester 6.
programmes.ib: Restricted: places ranked on your converted grade. Register on hochschulstart.de first (DoSV). 8-week pre-study internship, proof due when you re-register for semester 2.
programmes.selectionNote: Restricted via hochschulstart: ranked on your converted grade if oversubscribed, but every on-time EU/EEA applicant got a place in each of the last four years.

separateFrom.name: International Business and Management
separateFrom.reason: A different programme with its own name and page, taught in Kamp-Lintfort, not Kleve; nothing in the record says the two share a curriculum.

programmes.name: International Business and Management
programmes.about: A generalist business degree focused on digitalisation, sustainability and international markets, with a compulsory semester abroad in semester 5 and a final semester pairing a company internship with the thesis.
programmes.ib: Restricted: places ranked on your converted grade. Register on hochschulstart.de first (DoSV). 8-week pre-study placement, proof by re-enrolment for semester 4.
programmes.selectionNote: Restricted via hochschulstart: ranked on your converted grade if oversubscribed, but every on-time EU/EEA applicant got a place in each of the last four years.

programmes.name: International Relations
programmes.about: Politics, economics and law in an international setting: IR theory, institutions, peace and security first, then electives such as foreign policy, human rights and development, and an internship or semester abroad.
programmes.ib: Restricted: places ranked on your converted grade. Register on hochschulstart.de first (DoSV). 8-week pre-study placement, proof by re-enrolment for semester 4.
programmes.selectionNote: Restricted via hochschulstart: ranked on your converted grade if oversubscribed, but every on-time EU/EEA applicant got a place in each of the last four years.

programmes.name: International Taxation and Law
programmes.about: International and European tax law with business administration and accounting (corporate tax, VAT, transfer pricing, tax planning), and a compulsory work placement or semester abroad in semester 6.
programmes.ib: 8-week pre-study placement, proof due by re-enrolment for the 4th semester.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission (no NC): apply by the deadline with a recognised IB and B2 English and you get a place.

programmes.name: Mobility and Logistics
programmes.about: Planning and running transport, production and supply-chain systems with a sustainable-mobility angle; you specialise in logistics, technology or business from semester 4, then do an internship or semester abroad.
programmes.ib: Restricted: places ranked on your converted grade. Register on hochschulstart.de first (DoSV). 8-week pre-study placement, proof due when you re-register for semester 2.
programmes.selectionNote: Restricted via hochschulstart: ranked on your converted grade if oversubscribed, but every on-time EU/EEA applicant got a place in 2023 and 2025.

programmes.name: Nature-Inspired Materials
programmes.about: Chemistry, biology and materials science combined to develop sustainable materials modelled on nature; after three foundation semesters you choose biomaterials, material technology or management, then a compulsory internship or time abroad.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission (no NC): apply by the deadline with a recognised IB and B2 English and you get a place.

programmes.name: Sustainable Agriculture
programmes.about: Ecological farming and horticulture, from soil science and agroecology to precision and urban farming, with a specialisation from semester 4 and a 20-week farm internship or a semester abroad in semester 6.
programmes.ib: No pre-study placement required, but the programme head strongly recommends 8 weeks or more on a farm or horticultural business first.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission (no NC): apply by the deadline with a recognised IB and B2 English and you get a place.

programmes.name: Sustainable Tourism
programmes.about: Tourism studied through sustainable development, economics, sociology and ecology, using case studies, projects and field trips, with an internship or a semester abroad in semester 6.
programmes.ib: 8-week pre-study work placement (ideally related to tourism), proof due by re-enrolment for the 4th semester.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission (no NC): apply by the deadline with a recognised IB and B2 English and you get a place.

notes: Bachelor's start only in the winter semester (1 September), and every English one runs seven semesters, three and a half years.
Seven programmes are restricted and run through hochschulstart's DoSV, so you register there first for an applicant ID (BID) and number (BAN).
Admission letters for restricted programmes usually go out in early August, with a waiting-list round from late August.
